about: Golden questions for the AI assistant (chatbot:evaluate). Every expected fact is checked by hand against Docs/assistant-knowledge (the file is named in 'note'). 'sources': groups of document-title fragments; each group must match one passage given to the model (one group per part of the question). 'facts': groups of accepted spellings; each group must appear in the answer. Numbers match whole numbers only (30 does not match 300).
